critical_code_review_comments: Bug fully resolved but architectural debt remains: 28 handlers now duplicate the same 4-line project-fetch+_can_access_project block. This exact duplication is what caused the original miss. Strongly recommend extracting a shared FastAPI dependency such as `async def authorized_project(project_id: str, user: dict = Depends(require_auth)) -> dict: project = await get_project_by_id(project_id); if not project or not _can_access_project(user, project): raise HTTPException(404, 'Project not found'); return project`. This would eliminate ~80 lines and remove the class of bug entirely.

projects.py is now 1622 lines — splitting into projects_crud.py / projects_slides.py / projects_media.py / projects_audio.py / projects_annotations.py is increasingly overdue (already flagged in iteration_108 and iteration_109).
